quests.name: The Medallion of Faith
quests.objective: Retrieve the Medallion of Faith from Malor the Zealous in the Scarlet Bastion and bring it back to Aurius.
quests.description: Malor's Strongbox in the Scarlet Bastion holds the medallion. Give it to Aurius in the chapel before fighting the Baron.

quests.name: Aurius' Reckoning
quests.objective: Give Aurius the Medallion of Faith; he joins the fight against Baron Rivendare. Claim his reward after the battle.
quests.description: Give Aurius the Medallion of Faith before the Baron fight; speak to him after Baron Rivendare dies.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
quests.objective: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
quests.description: Any undead in Stratholme can drop Plagued Flesh Samples.

quests.name: The Active Agent
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: The Great Fras Siabi
quests.objective: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
quests.description: Newer Classic records call him Ezra Grimm. Clear the smoke shop, touch the tobacco box and kill the shopkeeper.

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
quests.description: Collect 5 Stratholme Holy Water from the supply crates in the streets; some crates spawn enemies.

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
quests.description: Kill Archivist Galford in the Scarlet Bastion and burn the archives.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
quests.objective: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
quests.description: Hand in The Archivist first, or Balnazzar's head will not start this quest.

quests.name: Above and Beyond
quests.objective: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
quests.description: Then Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and The Argent Hold, in Light's Hope Chapel, give the weapon or shield reward.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.objective: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to The Restless Souls.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.objective: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

quests.name: Demon Dogs
quests.objective: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

quests.name: Blood Tinged Skies
quests.objective: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

quests.name: Carrion Grubbage
quests.objective: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.objective: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.objective: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

quests.name: Of Lost Honor
quests.objective: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objective: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world. Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
quests.description: Take the painting hidden behind the twin-moons picture in Archivist Galford's room before you burn the archives.

quests.name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
quests.objective: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to Ramstein.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: To Kill With Purpose
quests.objective: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

quests.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
quests.objective: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

quests.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
quests.objective: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

quests.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
quests.objective: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

quests.name: The Corpulent One
quests.objective: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

quests.name: Ramstein
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

quests.name: Dead Man's Plea
quests.objective: Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
quests.description: Timed: rescue Ysida Harmon by killing Baron Rivendare within 45 minutes. Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to see Anthion.
